description:
Sellerise brings your Amazon business data into ChatGPT - clear, structured, and ready to analyze.

Connect your Sellerise account to ask questions about sales, profit, advertising, inventory, keyword rankings, Amazon Search Query Performance, reviews, reimbursements, payouts, Subscribe & Save, and overall account performance.

Get fast answers without digging through dashboards: compare periods, spot profit leaks, find inefficient ad spend, identify stock risks, and see which products, campaigns, keywords, or search terms need attention.

Use it to understand what changed, what is driving performance, and where your Amazon business may be losing money or missing opportunities.

Sellerise uses read-only access to your Amazon business data, so you can analyze performance and make better-informed decisions without modifying your account. Sellerise is Amazon ToS-compliant, helping you analyze and understand your business while staying aligned with Amazon’s rules.

defaultPrompt: Compare my Amazon performance for the last 30 days vs. the prior 30 days and recommend my top three actions
Find the products hurting profit most, explain why using sales, PPC, inventory, reviews, and keyword data, and suggest fixes.
Audit my PPC for wasted spend, high ACoS, search-term opportunities, and negative-keyword candidates. Prioritize the fixes.
